page.overview:
Who is Lloyd?

Lloyd is a minor antagonist in Final Fantasy Tactics. He is a loan shark who extorts Aerith in the trade city of Sal Ghidos.

In the original and War of the Lions versions, the Sal Ghidos monk has a randomized name but retains the unique portrait. The name Lloyd was made permanent in The Ivalice Chronicles.

At some point before Ramza Beoulve's arrival in Sal Ghidos, Lloyd loaned Aerith thirty thousand gil. Aerith sold flowers, but was unable to save up the requisite amount before the agreed upon due date.

During the events of chapter 4, "In the Name of Love", Lloyd and several of his cronies corned Aerith in the streets, blocking her escape. He greeted Aerith, sarcastically commenting on her flower-selling. When Aerith begged for more time, Lloyd grabbed her by the front of her dress and reminded her that she had long since missed the agreed-upon due date. He commented on Aerith's look and suggested "better ways" to earn gil than selling flowers, earning a laugh from one of his comrades.
